sections.title: 11.1 The Problem: LLMs are "Brains Without Hands"
sections.body:
> An LLM is like a brilliant expert locked in a room with only a notepad. They can think and write beautifully, but they can't GO anywhere or DO anything.

**Function Calling gives them "hands" — the ability to interact with the real world.**

sections.title: 11.2 What is Function Calling?
sections.body:
### Simple Definition
> **Function Calling allows an LLM to decide when to call external functions/tools and what parameters to pass to them — bridging AI reasoning with real-world actions.**

### The Flow

```
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                 FUNCTION CALLING FLOW                       │
│                                                             │
│  User: "What's the weather in Mumbai right now?"            │
│                        │                                    │
│                        ▼                                    │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────┐                       │
│  │           LLM REASONING          │                       │
│  │  "I don't know real-time data.   │                       │
│  │   I should call get_weather()    │                       │
│  │   with city='Mumbai'"            │                       │
│  └──────────────────────────────────┘                       │
│                        │                                    │
│          LLM says: "Call get_weather(city='Mumbai')"        │
│                        │                                    │
│                        ▼                                    │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────┐                       │
│  │         YOUR APPLICATION         │                       │
│  │  Actually calls the Weather API  │                       │
│  │  Returns: {"temp": 32, "cond":   │                       │
│  │            "Sunny", "humidity":  │                       │
│  │            "78%"}                │                       │
│  └──────────────────────────────────┘                       │
│                        │                                    │
│                        ▼                                    │
│  ┌──────────────────────────────────┐                       │
│  │           LLM AGAIN              │                       │
│  │  "The weather in Mumbai is 32°C  │                       │
│  │   and sunny with 78% humidity"   │                       │
│  └──────────────────────────────────┘                       │
│                                                             │
│  LLM never directly called the API!                         │
│  It just DECIDED to call it and YOUR code executed it.      │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

### KEY INSIGHT ⚡
> The LLM doesn't execute functions. It **DECIDES** which function to call and with what arguments. YOUR code actually runs the function and feeds results back to the LLM.

11.5 AI Agents: Function Calling on Steroids
sections.body:
### What is an AI Agent?
> An AI Agent is an LLM that can use tools **REPEATEDLY and AUTONOMOUSLY** to complete a complex multi-step task.

```
User: "Research the top 5 competitors of our product, 
       summarize their features, and create a comparison table"

AI AGENT LOOP:
┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│  Step 1: search_web("top competitors product X")        │
│  Step 2: search_web("competitor A features")            │
│  Step 3: search_web("competitor B features")            │
│  Step 4: search_web("competitor C features")            │
│  Step 5: create_table([A_data, B_data, C_data, ...])    │
│  Step 6: write_document(table)                          │
│  Final: "Here's your comparison table!" 🎉              │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

The agent DECIDES what tools to use, IN WHAT ORDER, with WHAT ARGUMENTS — all by itself!
